announcements.title: Diwali Holidays
announcements.content: Diwali holidays begin tomorrow. Wishing everyone a Happy Diwali!

announcements.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026-27 (Nursery to Class XII)
announcements.content: Master Mind Public School (MPBSE Affiliated, Main Road, Pipariya) invites applications for the upcoming 2026-27 session. Merit scholarships, digital smart classrooms, and safe bus transport are available. Register online or visit our administrative office.

announcements.title: Annual Inter-House Sports Meet & Athletics Trials
announcements.content: Our athletic sports complex will host track and field competitions, cricket, badminton, and kho-kho trials this Wednesday. Students must report in standard sports house uniform.

announcements.title: Quarterly Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) for Classes 1 to 12
announcements.content: Parent-Teacher Conference scheduled for this Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Parents are warmly invited to discuss academic progress and report cards with class teachers.

announcements.title: District High Scorers & Merit Felicitations Announced
announcements.content: Heartiest congratulations to our Class 10 and 12 toppers for achieving distinction marks across Pipariya district. Special recognition awards will be presented on Saturday.

jobs.title: PGT - Senior Physics & Mathematics Educator
jobs.description: Seeking dynamic educators for Senior Secondary Classes (XI & XII). Responsible for curriculum delivery, practical lab experiments, and state board examination preparation.
jobs.requirements: M.Sc in Physics or Mathematics with B.Ed. Minimum 2-3 years teaching experience in MPBSE or CBSE board schools.

jobs.title: TGT - English & Social Sciences Teacher
jobs.description: Responsible for nurturing communicative fluency, English literature, and social studies for Middle Wing (Classes VI to VIII).
jobs.requirements: B.A. / M.A. in English with B.Ed. Strong communicative pedagogy and passion for student engagement.

jobs.title: Primary Wing (PRT) - Mother Teacher
jobs.description: Looking for caring and creative early childhood educators for Nursery to Class 2. Focus on phonics, numeracy, and activity-based learning.
jobs.requirements: Graduation with D.El.Ed / NTT / B.Ed. Warm disposition and love for foundational learning.

jobs.title: Campus Physical Education Instructor & Sports Coach
jobs.description: Lead morning physical assemblies, athletic track events, basketball, cricket, and football training across our sports complex.
jobs.requirements: B.P.Ed or M.P.Ed with state/national level athletics experience.
